_comment: Privileged Entra ID roles subject to CA003 (phishing-resistant MFA for admins). Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). Listed by role display name; 07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1 resolves each name to its role template id at deploy time with Get-MgDirectoryRoleTemplate, so this file carries no tenant-specific ids. The two break-glass accounts are deliberately NOT members of these roles where avoidable; if they must be, CA003 excludes them explicitly.
